dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談ありがとうございます。はじめに性別、年齢、お住まいの都道府県を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, this is the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. To begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and the prefecture you live in?

dialogue.content: 男性 34歳 福岡県です
dialogue.English: I'm a 34-year-old male from Fukuoka Prefecture.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ご相談内容をお聞かせください
dialogue.English: Thank you. Please share what you would like to discuss.

dialogue.content: 恋愛に興味が湧きませんどうしたらいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I don't feel any interest in romantic relationships. What should I do?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、よければ具体的にどうして興味がわかないのか教えていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you're comfortable, could you share more specifically why you don't feel interested?

dialogue.content: 色々考え出すと面倒くさくなっていって自分のペースが崩れるので興味が無くなっていきます
dialogue.English: When I start thinking about all the different aspects, it becomes a hassle and throws off my own pace, so I lose interest.

dialogue.content: 自分のペースをとても大切にされているのですね。色々考えだすとというのはどういったことがありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It sounds like keeping your own pace is very important to you. What kinds of things come to mind when you say you think about all the different aspects?

dialogue.content: お金のこと、子どものこと、仕事のことなど...
dialogue.English: Things like money, children, work, and so on...

dialogue.content: お金の事もありますしパートナーの機嫌を伺いながら行動したりもし結婚して子供ができたらどうしようとか考え出したら嫌になって興味がなくなります
dialogue.English: There's money, and also having to act while being mindful of my partner's mood. And when I start thinking about things like what if we got married and had children, I get fed up and lose interest.

dialogue.content: 将来のことについて本当にたくさんのことを考えられていますね。周りのご友人の方々はご結婚されている方は多いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You're really considering many aspects of the future. Are many of your friends married?

dialogue.content: 何かお話とかはされますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever talk about these things with them?

dialogue.content: そうですね周りは結婚して子供もいる人は多いいです結婚している友達とはたまにご飯を食べながら話をしています
dialogue.English: Yes, many of my friends are married and have children. I sometimes talk with my married friends over a meal.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。その時にお話を聞いてみて何か感じたはございますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you listen to their stories, do you feel anything in particular?

dialogue.content: 羨ましいなと思う事があります親も心配させずにすむので
dialogue.English: Sometimes I feel envious, because it would also mean I wouldn't have to make my parents worry.

dialogue.content: 親御さんが心配されていることもしっかりと考えられているのですね。どういったところが羨ましいと感じますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You're also very considerate of your parents' concerns. What aspects do you find enviable?

dialogue.content: 同じ空間に他人と一緒にずっと入れる事が羨ましく感じます
dialogue.English: I feel envious of people who can stay in the same space with someone else for a long time.

dialogue.content: それは羨ましいことですよね。同じ空間には何人くらい一緒に入れるのがいいと感じますか？
dialogue.English: I can see how that would feel enviable. How many people do you feel comfortable sharing the same space with?

dialogue.content: パートナー、親御さん、子ども...
dialogue.English: A partner, your parents, children...

dialogue.content: 親しくなれば気にはなりませんが付き合いの浅い人がいると落ち着けなくなります
dialogue.English: Once I become close to someone, it doesn't bother me, but I can't relax when someone I'm not very familiar with is there.

dialogue.content: 確かに親しくない方がいるとその方の機嫌を考えて自分のペースを崩されて落ち着けなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. When you're with someone you're not close to, you worry about their mood, which disrupts your own pace and makes it hard to relax. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 親しい方ですと一緒にいても安心できそうですか？
dialogue.English: With someone you're close to, do you think you could feel at ease being together?

dialogue.content: 気にしなくていいので安心します
dialogue.English: I wouldn't have to worry, so I would feel at ease.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そういった方との恋愛だとしてみたいと感じますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you might like to try a relationship with someone like that?

dialogue.content: そうですね気にし過ぎなくていい人がいればそう思うかも知れません
dialogue.English: Yes, if there were someone I didn't have to worry too much about, I might feel that way.

dialogue.content: では、ご自身の周りでそういった方はいらっしゃいますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In that case, is there anyone like that around you?

dialogue.content: 思い当たる人はいません
dialogue.English: No one comes to mind.

dialogue.content: そうですか。このことを誰かご友人や身近な方に相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked about this with any friends or people close to you?

dialogue.content: 友達には相談しています
dialogue.English: I have talked about it with my friends.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for speaking with me today.
